status: Visual iteration for review; not art-approved
adaptations: Fort walls use repeated shorter modules, preserving facade proportions more closely. Thickness remains fitted to the whitebox.
Gate and return-wall upper vertices compressed above source y=5.8; originals remain intact.
PBR material tint/normal strength, ground stain overlays and warmer directional lighting tuned together.
Existing non-playable terrain mesh reused; background models have no added collision.
Replaced all stylized foliage with Poly Haven fern_02, weed_plant_02 and nettle_plant submeshes. Separate alpha maps explicitly sampled because supplied glTF albedo is JPEG.

Ten large crossed wooden_crate_02 cases replace 42 repeated small crates; original jump collider heights and central landing support are preserved. Upper rows rotate -8 or +11 degrees, with small visual overhang outside simplified collision.
Added an open case, a removed lid, broken barrel sections and staves. Cargo outside jump obstacles uses irregular positions and orientations.
Removed four stylized background trees; architecture and lighting otherwise stay as in iteration 2.
limits: The overall scene still has an early-3D appearance; this is not a retro art-direction approval or achieved realism.
Architecture silhouettes, repeated stone surfaces, simple terrain and several older props remain unresolved.
Simplified jump collisions do not match decorative crate overhangs exactly.
No target-platform performance budget or production optimization.
